title: 753. Number Of Corner Rectangles

examples.explanation: Only rows 1,3 with columns 2,4 form all-one corners.

hints: Fix one row at a time and look at every pair of 1s inside it as a potential base.
Keep a table counting how many earlier rows already contained each column pair; each prior occurrence closes that many new rectangles.
Summing over rows gives an O(m * n^2) scan with O(n^2) memory.
